# Physio exercises

## Status

Physio exercises: clamshells, bridges, calf raises. Intervals on Wednesday: six times 800 metres with two minutes rest. Race goal is to finish under two hours, without walking.

## Open questions

Rest day means really resting, a walk is fine. Knee felt sore after the hill session, skip hills this week. Drink before the long run, take a gel after one hour.

## Context

- Kate joins the Thursday run, slower pace that day.
- Strength training twice a week keeps the injuries away.
- Stretching after every run, ten minutes, no excuses.

## Notes

Weekly distance goes up by at most ten percent. Resting heart rate is down to 12 after three months.
